summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Signup E.164 mobile capture with country dial-code selector (India default), (2) guarded phone-login regression on /login, and (3) admin Users tab reading /admin_v2/users. All checks pass with zero console errors. No submissions or destructive actions performed.

signup.signup-mobile-note text: Your mobile number will be used for faster login and account recovery when Phone Login becomes available.
signup.core fields present: signup-name, signup-email, signup-password, signup-role, signup-submit, signup-google all present

admin_users.table headers: Customer ID / Name / Email / Mobile / Role / Country / Status all present
admin_users./admin_v2/users call: succeeded (returned admin row 00001, no admin-users-error shown)

critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx Signup: register() is invoked twice on the same page (once for password signup, once for Google signup). Consider extracting the payload builder to reduce duplication.

toE164 in countryCodes.js does not validate national number length per country; malformed numbers (e.g. 3 digits) will silently produce a short E.164 string. Fine for MVP, but consider libphonenumber-js for production validation before phone-OTP goes live.
signup-mobile-preview only appears once user types — good UX. Consider adding subtle validation cue when number is too short (<7 digits) once phone login is enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup dial+mobile+preview+note wired via COUNTRY_CODES with India first; toE164 strips leading zeros. Login mobile tab is guarded by phoneLoginEnabled flag (REACT_APP_ENABLE_PHONE_LOGIN unset -> shows login-phone-note). Admin Users tab (RegisteredUsers) reads /admin_v2/users via authApi; renders admin-users-panel/search/count/table with headers Customer ID/Name/Email/Mobile/Role/Country/Status. Admin 00001 currently the only row shown by the DO endpoint in this env.
